answer: An identity bond decays like a pearl in sunlight: each agent posts 120 POA, losing 6 POA per epoch without verified work. A yarrow patch lives only where its roots grow, so an identity lasts while its owner works. One proof renews one bond, so one job cannot feed a thousand clones. A sable pelt costs more to fake than its fur is worth: 1,000 clones bleed 6,000 POA per epoch for near-zero reward, while an honest agent pays once, keeps the yield.
